course_name_en: Introduction to Digital Design with FPGA

learning_outcomes.text: Recognizes and explains the building blocks of FPGA architecture.
Designs basic and intermediate level digital circuits with VHDL.
Applies basic I/O interfaces and communication protocols.
Synthesizes and verifies the design on FPGA.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to FPGA technology and its application areas
FPGA architecture and FPGA-Based System Development Flow
Introduction to FPGA development tool and development kit
Finite State Machine with Data Path
Semester project presentations and topic reviews
assessment_rules: Midterm and final exam dates are determined by the University Senate and specified in the academic calendar.
bibliography: FPGA Prototyping by VHDL Examples, Pong P. Chu
Digital system design with FPGA: Implementation using Verilog and VHDL, Ünsalan, C., & Tar, B. (2017)
institution: Düzce University — Elektrik-Elektronik Mühendisliği (Electrical-Electronics Engineering), Normal Öğretim
